description: Security-focused resource watch: sustained CPU saturation, fast disk fill, process storms, and collapsing memory, each judged as a rate or a trend over its own rolling window.
name: resource_sentinel

signals.description: CPU stayed at or over the cpu_high_pct tunable across the whole sampling window -- the shape of a miner or a spin loop, not a compile.
signals.name: cpu_saturation_sustained

signals.description: Free space on the watched mount is shrinking faster than the disk_fill_gb_per_hour tunable -- log flooding or evidence destruction at pace.
signals.name: disk_fill_velocity

signals.description: The process count grew by more than the process_growth tunable inside the window -- fork-bomb or runaway-spawn shape.
signals.name: process_storm

signals.description: Available memory fell steadily toward the mem_floor_pct tunable across the window -- a leak or a memory bomb in progress.
signals.name: memory_exhaustion_trend
